title: 第17章 獠牙初显君子肃杀第18章 雕鴞冷漠
slug: 朝廷鹰犬没挨过六扇门的刀
content_zh:
獠牙初显，君子肃杀。
营帐内
“今晚麻烦武伯注意楚夷的动向了，还有延夏，让戍卫都准备好。”李君肃坐在主位，语气淡然。
“我知道了少爷。”李武闻言点了点头示意自己知道了。
“遵命少爷。”李延夏闻言更是恭敬的一拱手。
虽然不知道自家大哥刚刚说的是什麽，但只要知道楚家老二跟楚大力的副手会在营帐内下毒杀害楚大力。
他只需要管什麽时候冲锋就好，就像自家大哥去负责矿山利润还有主家交流，自己只需要在营帐内管好弟兄们就行了。
“很好，今晚行动。”李君肃看着一直走神的李延夏掷地有声的应答，看了看李长春，起身离开。
马车上。
“你们兄弟俩分工负责的都挺不错的。”李君肃夸奖着。
一个帅才一个将才才是绝配，他需要的不是为什麽今晚攻打楚家营帐，他需要的是遵命。
“嘿嘿，延夏跟我境界可是差不多的，可能还要快我一步晋升宗法。”李长春得意的夸着自家老弟。
自家傻弟弟一根筋，但这一根筋在操练武者上可是很不错的，不然也不会让宗法境的楚大力问攻下李家能有什麽好处了。
“还是要加油，防守尚可进攻不足，迟早会消亡。”李武开口提醒。
“武大人说的是。”李长春立马应下。
“好了，等今晚的好戏吧。”李君肃闭上眼，开始修炼。
他很期待，今晚的大戏。
夜晚很快到来。
李家，大厅。
“少爷，楚夷已经出发了。”李武在门外传声。

“出发。”一袭黑色劲装的李君肃拿起桌上的萤白色短刀。
楚家营帐
“准备好了？”楚夷看着程亮。
“准备好了，必定让他有来无回。”程亮自信开口。
“你打算让戍卫先上？”楚夷问道。
他进来的时候看着眼神戒备的戍卫，皱了皱眉。
“他中了毒，杀不了多少戍卫，到时候我们加紧操练军阵，李长春来不及支援李家的，更何况他也只是一个≈x38c9;室境界，没什麽用的。”程亮解释着。
“李长春有没有可能知道我们在操练军阵？”楚夷问道。
“没有可能，大部分时间是楚大力用境界屠杀。”程亮拍着胸膛保证。
“那行，接下来就让戍卫先上。”楚夷闻言点了点头。
用戍卫再削弱一次楚大力，他觉得能行。
“你快躲起来，他应该很快就到了。”程亮吩咐道。
content_en:
The fangs are beginning to show, and the gentleman kills them with fear.
Inside the tent
"Uncle Wu, please pay attention to Chu Yi's movements tonight, as well as Yanxia, and have the guards ready." Li Junsu sat in the main seat and spoke calmly.
"I understand, young master." Li Wu nodded when he heard this to indicate that he understood.
"I obey, young master." Upon hearing this, Li Yanxia bowed her hands respectfully.
Although I don’t know what my eldest brother just said, I just know that the second son of the Chu family and Chu Dali’s deputy will poison Chu Dali in the camp.
He only needs to manage when to charge, just like his elder brother is responsible for the profits of the mine and the communication between the master and the family, and he only needs to manage his brothers in the camp.
"Very good, let's take action tonight." Li Junsu looked at Li Yanxia, ​​who had been distracted, and responded loudly, looked at Li Changchun, stood up and left.
On the carriage.
"You two brothers are very good at dividing labor and responsibilities." Li Junsu praised.
A handsome man and a general are a perfect match. What he needs is not why he attacked the Chu family's camp tonight, but what he needs is to obey orders.
"Hehe, Yanxia is at the same level as me. Maybe he will be promoted to the patriarchal clan faster than me." Li Changchun proudly praised his brother.
My silly younger brother has a weak point, but he is very good at training as a warrior. Otherwise, Chu Dali, who is in the patriarchal realm, would not ask what benefits he would get from capturing the Li family.
"We still have to work harder. The defense is still insufficient and the offense is not enough. Sooner or later, it will die." Li Wu reminded.
"Master Wu said yes." Li Changchun agreed immediately.
"Okay, let's wait for tonight's show." Li Junsu closed his eyes and started practicing.
He was looking forward to tonight's big show.
Night comes quickly.
Li family, lobby.
"Master, Chu Yi has already set off." Li Wu said from outside the door.
"Let's go." Li Junsu, dressed in black, picked up the white short knife on the table.
Chu family tent
"Ready?" Chu Yi looked at Cheng Liang.
"When you are ready, we will make sure that he never comes back." Cheng Liang said confidently.
"Are you going to let the guards go up first?" Chu Yi asked.
When he came in, he looked at the guard with wary eyes and frowned.
"He was poisoned and won't be able to kill many guards. When the time comes, we will step up military formation drills. Li Changchun will not have time to support the Li family. What's more, he is only in the "house level" and is of no use." Cheng Liang explained.
"Is it possible that Li Changchun knew that we were practicing military formations?" Chu Yi asked.
"It's impossible. Chu Dali used his realm to massacre most of the time." Cheng Liang assured, patting his chest.
"Okay, let the guards go first." Chu Yi nodded after hearing this.
He thought it would work to use the garrison to weaken Chu Dali again.
"Hurry up and hide, he should be here soon." Cheng Liang ordered.
